test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: We need to accept that people will act with their own best interests as the priority.
The fossil fuels, coal and petroleum will ultimately be exhausted.
Combustion of fossil fuels pollute our environment; we need to use these resources judiciously.
Sustainable management of natural resources is an easy task.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sustainable management of natural resources is an easy task**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sustainable management of natural resources** is a **complex challenge**, facing **numerous obstacles**:

 
 
• **Competing interests**: Balancing economic development, environmental protection, and social needs can be difficult, leading to conflicts.
 
• **Limited knowledge**: Fully understanding the long-term impacts of resource use and developing effective solutions requires ongoing research and innovation.
 
• **Lack of enforcement**: Sustainable practices may require regulations and incentives, which can be challenging to implement and enforce effectively.
 
• Therefore, while acknowledging individual interests and the reality of finite resources, managing them sustainably involves addressing multifaceted challenges, making it far from an easy task.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Sustainable resource management** entails **preserving natural resources** so they can be used effectively and not abused for personal gain.

 
 
• **Natural resource management**:
 
• It is imperative that natural resource management be **done for the benefit of present and future generations**.
 
• It entails **caring for the environment of marine life and biodiversity **as well as the management of resources including coal, water, soil, land, animals, and plants.
 
• Considering the requirements of the next generation in order to ensure that they can profit from natural resources as well.
 
• It enables us to leave them in a better world.
